a. FIX runBuildLoop:302-306 FIRST — the tick posts /dispatch/complete and never reads the response; .catch swallows it. Rejections are invisible today. This is why tickets show claim acks, live workers, and neither a done nor a block reason.
b. /dispatch/complete accepts on DEPLOY EVIDENCE (commit + version + CF PUT success), records done immediately. Verification runs ASYNC and DOWNGRADES to blocked with the real error if it later proves blank/500/1101.
c. Durable async verify — DO alarm, NOT ctx.waitUntil, which dies with the request. verification_state: pending | passed | downgraded. Pending is a RED on get_state and does not count toward completion rate.
